name: Riga Open 2017

venue.name: http://www.rigaplaza.lv/en/
venue.details: On the first floor in the event area. Follow the signs.

information:
Riga Open is the biggest 1 day speedcubing competition in the Baltic countries.
Next competition will be held on 1 April in Riga. 6 disciplines where you can take part yourself or see Latvian best speedcubers. 

The event takes place for 1 days and the participation cost is 5 EUR. If you participate only in 3x3 event, participation is for free.
